snippet.title: Tri6: Infinite 2 | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Race into the neon future with Tri6: Infinite 2, the next evolution of high-speed arcade racing.
Dodge deadly obstacles, master tight turns, unleash powerful abilities, and survive endlessly generating tracks that challenge you every run. With improved vehicle handling, smarter AI opponents, 10 unique powerups, weekly challenges, and new high-tech machines to pilot, every race is a fresh fight for survival.

How long can you stay alive on the digital highway?
